rawContent: I am on Richard Glover's political forum tonight @abcsydney talking 30 negative news polls (and a partridge in a pear tree), live animal exports, #Metoo and Naplan. Should be fun.
Here’s what I gleaned tonight about the slogans powerful white guys are using against #Metoo ‘puritanical’ ‘political correctness’ (surprise,surprise) and ‘censorship’.  Sigh.

@MelitaWhite @Kon__K I think it is probably unrealistic to expect mea culpas from many perpetrators. What #Metoo has done is make the world riskier for abusers and safer for the vulnerable and that is an entirely good thing. Cosby verdict helps too.
